title: Samay Raina Shares Diwali Photo With Medha Shankr, Rumours Return
excerpt: The comedian posted a Diwali picture with the 12th Fail actress from his Mumbai bash, weeks after telling Varun Dhawan on Koffee With Karan that he was chilling with his girlfriend.
body:
• Comedian Samay Raina shared a Diwali photo on his Instagram story posing with actress Medha Shankr at his Mumbai Diwali bash, reigniting dating rumours that neither has confirmed.
  • A second photo from the party, shared by guest Shakshi Shetty, showed Medha Shankr posing with Raina's mother, Sweety Raina.
  • Weeks earlier, on Koffee With Karan Season 9, Raina told Varun Dhawan on a call that he was "chilling with my girlfriend" but did not name her.
  • Medha Shankr is best known as the actress in the Hindi film 12th Fail; she had not posted about the Diwali bash on her own Instagram, according to both reports.

A Diwali photo that restarted the conversation

Stand-up comedian and YouTuber Samay Raina has again become the subject of dating speculation after sharing photographs from his Diwali celebrations in Mumbai. According to Filmibeat and Zoom TV, Raina hosted an intimate Diwali bash at his home and shared glimpses of the festivities on his Instagram stories, including a photograph of himself posing with actress Medha Shankr.

In the photo described by Filmibeat, Medha Shankr was wearing a deep red Anarkali suit, while Raina wore a cream-coloured kurta-pyjama. Zoom TV described the gathering the same way — a party at his Mumbai residence attended by several prominent figures from the entertainment industry.

Among the guests named by the two outlets were Varun Dhawan, Zakir Khan, Munawar Faruqui, Kiku Sharda and Ashish Chanchlani. Filmibeat's list also included Veer Pahariya, Chandan Prabhakar and Shaaron Verma. Both reports said it was Medha Shankr's presence, in particular, that drew the most attention from followers.

The second photo, with Raina's mother

Attention intensified after a second image from the celebrations began circulating online. Both Filmibeat and Zoom TV reported that a photograph shared by guest Shakshi Shetty showed Medha Shankr posing with Raina's mother, Sweety Raina.

Zoom TV noted that while neither Raina nor Shankr has officially confirmed the nature of their relationship, the actress's inclusion in a family-oriented setting fueled further discussion among fans and observers. Filmibeat reported the same point in different words: Medha Shankr had not shared anything about the bash on her own Instagram, even as the comedian's photo with her drew wide attention online.

"At present, I am chilling with my girlfriend."

The 'chilling with girlfriend' comment

The Diwali photo landed weeks after a brief comment that had already set off speculation. During an episode of Koffee With Karan Season 9 that aired in late October 2026, Varun Dhawan called Raina during a game segment. Raina casually revealed that he was "chilling with my girlfriend," according to Filmibeat's account.

Zoom TV reported the same exchange: during a segment of the show, Varun Dhawan placed a call to Raina, who mentioned he was spending time with his girlfriend. Crucially, both outlets stressed what Raina did not say. He stopped short of disclosing her identity, prompting fans to speculate whether he was referring to Medha Shankr.

That distinction matters. Raina confirmed, in his own words on the show as reported, that he has a girlfriend. Neither report says he named Medha Shankr as that girlfriend, and neither Raina nor Shankr has confirmed a relationship with each other.

Who Medha Shankr is

Medha Shankr is an actress best known to wider audiences for the Hindi film 12th Fail. Both Filmibeat and Zoom TV referred to her in their reports as the "12th Fail actress," and Filmibeat described the rumours of an alleged romance between Raina and Shankr as having been "doing the rounds on the internet for quite some time" before the Diwali pictures appeared.

Where things stand

For diaspora fans who follow Raina's comedy and Shankr's film work online, the story is a familiar social-media cycle: a festive photo, a family picture and a weeks-old talk-show line combined into fresh speculation. As of both reports, the position has not changed — Raina has kept his girlfriend's identity under wraps, Shankr has not posted about the gathering, and, in Zoom TV's words, the nature of their relationship "remains a subject of public conjecture rather than confirmed fact."
